# AI search context file for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI

> Jon Grayson is a Director of UX & Design based in Washington, DC, with 25+ years building digital products. He runs Grayson Design Partners (graysondp.com), a design and technology studio.

## What this site is
Jon Grayson's personal portfolio and professional website. It showcases UX/design case studies, AI/ML workflow lessons, and interactive data visualization projects including a real-time global intelligence dashboard and Pittsburgh crime heatmap.

## Key pages
- **Homepage:** https://www.jongrayson.com/ — overview of capabilities, AI consulting, and intelligence work
- **Case Studies:** https://www.jongrayson.com/casestudies/ — 5 detailed UX/design case studies (onboarding, AI workflows, design systems, mobile growth, behavioral design)
- **AI Playbook Lessons:** https://www.jongrayson.com/lessons/ — 9 practical lessons on AI-augmented workflows (constraint-first prompting, vetting loops, quality checks, knowledge hygiene, workflow augmentation, research synthesis, skill preservation, iteration depth)
- **Intel Dashboard:** https://www.jongrayson.com/intel/ — interactive global intelligence dashboard with real-time data visualization
- **Resume:** https://www.jongrayson.com/resume/ — professional experience and credentials

## Services
- UX/UI design and design systems

- Data visualization and intelligence dashboards

## Notes
- Site is built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no framework
- Hosted on DreamHost
- Intel dashboard uses Three.js for 3D globe visualization
- Case studies cover work from BlankPage, AI workflows, design systems, mobile-first growth, and behavioral design
